title: Golden 2D Cinematic Edge Cases - Distance, Dialogue, Quantity, Continuity
creativeIntent: A schema-valid CURRENT-grounded teaching film that deliberately exercises difficult 2D cinematic situations without inventing 3D. It demonstrates distant scale, approach by screen occupancy, grouped quantity, edge entrances, crossing continuity, dialogue near/far, overscan, retreat, and a calm release. Every shot states its visible evidence so Devora learns to direct consequences rather than merely name camera moves.

beats.storyClaim: A huge space environment dominates the frame while the command ship is almost insignificant at the far left.

actions.subject: command_ship
actions.result: The ship remains tiny enough that the location and scale relationship are immediately readable.

camera.subject: command_ship
camera.purpose: Prove that an important object may begin extremely small instead of filling the frame.

beats.evidence: The ship occupies roughly five percent of frame width and the environment clearly dominates.

beats.storyClaim: The same ship approaches by becoming larger and moving toward a stable screen mark, not by inventing a new 3D view angle.

actions.subject: command_ship
actions.result: The ship enters from screen left and settles at its authored mark.

actions.subject: command_ship
actions.result: The visible size increase plus horizontal travel communicates approach in 2D.

camera.subject: command_ship
camera.purpose: Track gently while the ship itself supplies the dominant travel vector.

beats.evidence: Identity is unchanged from S01; only screen position, occupancy and motion establish the approach.

beats.storyClaim: Three identical command ships are visible as a formation, forcing quantity to be treated as visual evidence rather than metadata.

actions.subject: enemy_formation
actions.result: Three readable instances form a loose triangle rather than collapsing to one representative object.

actions.subject: enemy_formation
actions.result: The formation becomes the new threat without erasing the surrounding scale.

camera.subject: enemy_formation
camera.purpose: Reveal additional space and three distinct threat silhouettes.

beats.evidence: Exactly three ships are visible at once. A single ship is not acceptable evidence for count=3.

beats.storyClaim: The hero travels left-to-right while the threat remains on the right, creating a readable convergence without reversing screen direction arbitrarily.

actions.subject: command_ship
actions.result: Hero motion stays left-to-right through the whole beat.

actions.subject: command_ship
actions.result: The geometry visibly communicates convergence before any impact is claimed.

camera.subject: command_ship
camera.purpose: Follow enough to preserve the hero vector while keeping the distant target readable.

beats.evidence: Hero foreground movement and distant target coexist in one readable frame; direction does not flip between cuts.

beats.storyClaim: The attack produces a visible consequence: the enemy formation breaks and one logical member is destroyed.

actions.subject: enemy_formation
actions.result: One member receives the impact while the others remain legible.

actions.subject: enemy_formation
actions.result: The destroyed member disappears; the surviving formation no longer reads as the original intact triangle.

camera.subject: enemy_formation
camera.purpose: Cut closer only because the story now requires impact readability.

beats.evidence: The post-impact visual state is different from S03. A named impact with no visible change would fail the beat.

beats.storyClaim: Green speaks while Red remains visibly present as the smaller listener. Dialogue identity is not replaced by a world actor workaround.

dialogue.speaker: green_pilot
dialogue.text: We broke their formation. Do not chase them into the dark.

camera.subject: green_pilot
camera.purpose: Green is NEAR/larger; Red stays FAR/smaller in the same dialogue rectangle.

beats.evidence: Both identities remain visible and distinct. The active speaker receives emphasis without changing either identity.

beats.storyClaim: Red answers, and the near/far emphasis reverses while the dialogue space remains locked.

dialogue.speaker: red_pilot
dialogue.text: Then we make them choose the distance.

camera.subject: red_pilot
camera.purpose: Reverse emphasis by cut, not by decorative camera drift during locked dialogue.

beats.evidence: Red becomes the larger near speaker; Green remains visible and smaller. Identity never swaps.

beats.storyClaim: The command ship passes very close to camera, intentionally overscanning the frame before exiting right.

actions.subject: command_ship
actions.result: The ship crosses the frame and intentionally crops against the edges.

actions.subject: command_ship
actions.result: The pass has a clear end state: the ship exits screen right.

camera.subject: command_ship
camera.purpose: Let subject motion create the energy; do not pile a second large camera move on top.

beats.evidence: Cropping is intentional because screenWidthFraction exceeds 1.0, and the object clearly exits after the pass.

beats.storyClaim: The surviving threat becomes smaller and farther away, restoring negative space and proving retreat visually.

actions.subject: enemy_survivors
actions.result: Two surviving ships leave toward screen right and become visually minor before disappearing.

camera.subject: enemy_survivors
camera.purpose: Restore environmental scale and show that the threat is receding rather than merely being declared defeated.

beats.evidence: Two small survivors occupy little frame area and visibly leave the combat space.

beats.storyClaim: The film ends quietly on environment and dialogue aftermath rather than another gratuitous close-up.

dialogue.speaker: green_pilot
dialogue.text: Hold here. Let the silence tell us whether they are gone.

camera.subject: green_pilot
camera.purpose: Release tension by returning visual weight to the environment and giving the final line room.

beats.evidence: The composition is visibly calmer and wider than the battle and dialogue peaks, creating an actual ending state.
